gen-dafont-redux-gf-ubuntu-sans: Contemporary and geometric, Redux spreads its wide-set letters out with a big entrance. What stands out most is the gap in stroke: Ubuntu Sans is a sans with tubular, pipe-like lines that never swell, while Redux modulates moderately.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-yaldevi: Wide-spaced and openly geometric, Redux makes a big entrance into every curve. Yaldevi, a sans-serif with an openly turned e and outsized lowercase, would keep paragraphs flowing without any fuss.
gen-dafont-riesling-fs-gambetta: Riesling sets heavy stems against hairline serifs, tightly knit and vintage-feeling, with extreme weight shifts. Gambetta, a serif with gentler shifts, takes the sustained reading Riesling was never meant for, leaving Riesling the drama.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-aldrich: Dreamy and ethereal, Starborn scatters big stretches of blank space between its letters. Aldrich keeps a bent-paperclip line with no swelling and a tall x-height, so the two share a page smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-bangla: Dreamy and drifting, Starborn leaves wide gaps between every letter. Anek Bangla, a sans with generous s curves and a short climb to the ascenders, does the quiet reading work Starborn leaves alone.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-gujarati: Drifting, dark-striped and dreamy, Starborn spaces its letters very far apart. Anek Gujarati handles the plain work of reading, with lowercase rivaling the capitals, while Starborn supplies the mood.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-anek-odia: Starborn spreads its letters across big stretches of blank space. Anek Odia, a sans-serif whose rounds stay unlatched and whose capitals barely rise above lowercase, gives it something steady to sit beside.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-arimo: Starborn leaves big stretches of blank space between letters, with a thick, dark stripe of lowercase running through every line. Starborn drifts; Arimo, a sans with a tall mean line, holds things steady.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-athiti: Starborn drifts, dreamy and ethereal, with wide gaps between its letters. Athiti, a sans cut like single-width sign-shop vinyl, does the steady work that Starborn's drifting never could, its s open to see through.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Starborn is dreamy and ethereal, with big stretches of blank space between letters and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Atkinson Hyperlegible stays approachable, its wide-set s terminals doing the plain talking.
